outfit_card.silhouette: A layered couture ensemble featuring a structured corset bodice, flowing sheer tulle overskirt, and trailing ribbons, with a distinct high-slit layered skirt revealing the legs and a draped, organic capelet structure.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Curved golden antler headpiece, delicate gold chain forehead drape with emerald drop, and small green leaf hair clips.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Strapless, structured bodice with gold filigree framing and emerald beadwork. A sheer, pleated green tulle overlay forms a draped capelet on the shoulders, paired with gold arm cuffs and delicate chains.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered skirt with a high front slit, featuring a voluminous, translucent green tulle overskirt, a solid green mini-skirt beneath, and gold-trimmed strappy heels with floral accents.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A translucent green gemstone pendant, scattered gold and emerald floral hairpins, and delicate green leaf motifs.
